描述_EN: fragmentary monochromatic tapestry square composed of a stylized vine leaf design in the center. the tapestry yoke had been added by sewing to the backing fabric, as shown in the gap. this element, inscribed in a square, is framed by a stylized vine scroll simplified into a succession of medallions surrounding vine leaves. these are sometimes inhabited by birds or other unidentifiable elements.
描述_ZN: carré de tapisserie monochrome fragmentaire composé au center d'un motif de feuilles de vigne stylisé. 挂毯的枷锁是通过缝制在地布上的，在缝隙处可以看到。 这个元素，刻在一个正方形中，被一个风格化的藤蔓卷轴框住，简化成一个围绕着藤蔓叶子的连续的奖章。 这些有时是由鸟类或其他无法识别的元素居住的。
时期: 埃及 拜占庭统治时期
